faq.a: Leonida is the fictional U.S. state in which Grand Theft Auto VI is set. It is Rockstar's fictional analogue for Florida and is home to Vice City and its surrounding regions.

faq.q: When was Leonida first named in GTA 6?
faq.a: Leonida was named in the official Trailer 1 Newswire announcement on 5 December 2023, which described the game as heading to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond.
Yes. According to the record, Leonida is Rockstar's fictional analogue of the state of Florida, and GTA 6 is set entirely within it.

faq.q: What regions are part of Leonida in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar has officially named several regions inside Leonida, including Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Grassrivers, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park, alongside the central city of Vice City.

faq.q: How large is the state of Leonida in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar has not stated Leonida's overall size or given official boundaries in this record. Only the named regions within it, and its role as the game's setting, have been confirmed.

howWeKnow: Leonida traces back to Rockstar's first official trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI, where the Newswire announcement of 5 December 2023 named the state directly. GTA 6's own website has repeated the name since, making this a first-party, official source rather than a fan theory. The record was current as of the trailer's release date.
